Resolves #21280

A dialog that was moved resizes again, and its resize preview follows the pointer. `Neo.plugin.Resizable` gets `styleConfig`, the style config it writes the resize into, on its owner and on its drag proxy. The default stays `wrapperStyle`. `dialog.Base` passes `style`, the config its moves and its reopen already use, so the later gesture wins.

Evidence: L2 (real pointer gestures on `examples/dialog` in Chromium, red on `dev` and green on this head) → L2 required (AC-1 and AC-2 are browser geometry).

Change class: restoration (`fix`). agent-preflight: not hosted here; the baseline guards run in CI.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1: move then resize renders the resized size; resize then move keeps it | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/dialog/MoveResize.spec.mjs`, arms 1 and 3 |
| AC-2: the resize preview follows the pointer | CI-covered: `MoveResize.spec.mjs`, arm 2 (the preview is 75 px wider halfway through a +150 px drag) |
| AC-3: a moved dialog reopens at its moved geometry | No change to that path: `dialog.Base#onDragEnd` writes `style`, `animateShow` reads it, and neither is touched. A resize now writes `style` too, so a resized dialog also reopens at its size. |
| AC-4: an e2e spec pins AC-1 and AC-2, red on `dev` | Arms 1 and 2 fail on `dev` `ae99006670` (below); arm 3 passes on both as the regression guard |
| AC-5: grid and table column resizing as on `dev` | The header plugins keep the default `wrapperStyle`. Header resize e2e and unit specs: below |

## Deltas from ticket
- **The resize moved to `style`, not the move to `wrapperStyle`.** The intake prescription moved the dialog's move into `wrapperStyle`. A dialog created with `style: {left, top}`, as `examples/dialog`'s second dialog is, keeps those keys in `style` through `animateShow`, so they would mask every move written to `wrapperStyle`. The ticket body records the revision and a Contract Ledger for `styleConfig`.
- **AC-4 asks for an e2e spec rather than a unit spec.** The move reads the drag proxy's rect from the main thread.
- `test/playwright/unit/plugin/Resizable.spec.mjs` builds its plugin by hand, so its stub gains `styleConfig: 'wrapperStyle'`, the default.
- `buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs` gains `test/playwright/e2e/dialog`, so the engine tier runs the new spec; `E2eCiSelection.spec.mjs` failed until it did.
- Out of scope, noted in a defect-note: `test/playwright/e2e/table/HeaderResize.spec.mjs`'s arm "header drag-reorder still works after a resize" fails locally on unchanged `dev` `ae99006670`, 2 of 2 runs.

## Test Evidence
Red-first on `dev` `ae99006670`, the worktree before the change: `MoveResize.spec.mjs` arm 1 measured 512 px after a +150 px resize of a moved 512 px dialog, and arm 2 a 512 px preview halfway. Arm 3 passed. On this head all three pass.

AC-5: `table/HeaderResize.spec.mjs` and `grid/HeaderResizeRectSync.spec.mjs` give 8 of 9 here, and the failing arm fails the same on unchanged `dev`. The unit specs of `plugin/Resizable`, `table/header/Resizable`, the grid column-resize syncs, `timeline/EventDragZone` and `dialog/` pass (41). Full unit tier: 7884 passed, 2 skipped, none failed.
